#include < iostream > using namespace std ; typedef int Data ; class Node {
Node * next ; Node * prev ; // next link , previous link Node ( Data d = 0 , Node * n = NULL , Node * p = NULL ) { data = d ; next = n ; prev = p ; }

Node * head ; Node * tail ; // * first , * last or * header , * trailer public : DoublyLinkedList ( ) { head = tail = NULL ; } void InsertFront ( Data d ) { // Insert node to the front of doubly linked list if ( IsEmpty ( ) ) head = tail = new Node ( d , NULL , NULL ) ;
head head- > prev = new Node ( d , head , NULL ) ; } void InsertRear ( Data d ) { // Insert node to the rear of doubly linked list if ( IsEmpty ( ) ) head = tail = new Node ( d , NULL , NULL ) ;

tail tail next = new Node ( d , NULL , tail ) ; } void PrintListForward ( ) { // Print linked list in the forward direction cout << " [ head ] = > " ; for ( Node * p = head ; p ! = NULL ; p = p- > next ) cout << p- > data << " = > " ; cout << " [ null ] " << endl ; } void PrintListBackward ( ) { // Print linked list in the backward direction
for ( Node * p = tail ; p = NULL ; p = p → prev ) cout << p- > data << " = > " ; cout << " [ null ] " << endl ; } bool IsEmpty ( ) { return head == NULL ; }
